messages:
Elena Nguyen: Hi team — quick Q: I accepted the offer and my start is next week, but I have to fly out tomorrow for an urgent family matter. Can we do remote I-9 verification and is there any way to get a consulate/visa appointment letter or an expedite? I'm currently on F-1 OPT (EAD valid until Oct).

Maya Patel: Hey Elena — we can do remote I-9 via an Authorized Representative. We'll need scans of the originals and a live video verification. We can also provide an employment verification/travel letter for the consulate. Legal can advise on expedite for visa appointments but can't guarantee. Please upload docs to the secure HR portal now (link) and ping me. :handshake:

Raj Singh: I can act as the Authorized Rep to complete Section 2. Quick steps: 1) Upload scanned copies to the portal; 2) Book a 15-min video with me (live view of originals); 3) I'll sign Section 2 as "Authorized Representative" and note the rep name. You should still present originals to employer when you're back if possible.

Maya Patel: Also note — if you end up getting stamped overseas, payroll usually isn't affected as long as your I-9 is completed before first paycheck. Benefits enrollment might shift one pay period depending on timing. We'll coordinate with Payroll.

Amir Johnson: Don't stress — we can push your onboarding by a week if needed. Team will cover the first two days of work. Start date flexibility is ok. :thumbsup:

Elena Nguyen: Thanks, that's reassuring. Can you confirm the exact docs I should upload? Also, what should I show on the video call?

Raj Singh: Docs checklist below — please upload PDFs or clear photos. On the video call you'll hold each original up so I can see the front/back.

```
Required documents for remote I-9 verification:
- passport photo page (clear image)
- I-94 record (pdf or screenshot)
- EAD card (front and back)
- Offer letter (PDF)
- DS-160 confirmation (if you plan to book a visa interview)
- SSN card (if you already have one)
```

Raj Singh: For the call, have originals on a plain background, good lighting, and show both sides of any card. I'll record a short note in the HR system stating I verified originals via live video as the Authorized Rep.

Maya Patel: I've drafted a consulate letter template. Legal (Aisha) will review and we can mark it "for urgent travel" if you provide appointment confirmation or evidence of emergency. PeopleOpsBot: reminder — do not share PII in public channels; use the secure portal.

Aisha Kapoor: Hi Elena — I can support an expedite request to the consulate if there's a documented emergency (medical/funeral). Please DM me your appointment confirmation and any supporting docs. I will prepare the formal letter for the consulate/US employer verification. I cannot promise the embassy will expedite, but we'll include as much supporting info as we can.

Elena Nguyen: Uploaded everything to the portal (files: passport.pdf, i94.pdf, ead_front.jpg, ead_back.jpg, offer.pdf). I'm at SFO terminal — can we do the video now?

Maya Patel: We're available. Raj — you good to join for the video? Amir: I'll be on in case we need to shift the start date.

Raj Singh: Available in 5. Scheduling a 15-min Zoom now.

(15 minutes later)

Raj Singh: I-9 video completed. I verified originals on video, completed Section 2 as Authorized Representative and uploaded the signed form to the employee file. Note added: "Verified via live video on 1779012365; rep: Raj Singh."

Maya Patel: Thanks Raj — I logged the note in People Ops and flagged Payroll to ensure first paycheck won't be blocked. Aisha — moving the consulate letter to you for review.

Aisha Kapoor: Received the appointment details and emergency documentation from Elena via DM. Drafting the letter now and will send in ~30m.

PeopleOpsBot: reminder_sent: Please ensure original documents are presented to an employer or authorized representative within 3 business days of return if required by policy.

Elena Nguyen: Huge thanks everyone — I really appreciate the quick turnaround. Will update if anything changes.

Amir Johnson: Safe travels, Elena. Team will see you when you're back. :airplane:

Maya Patel: Closing loop: I-9 is done, consulate letter in progress, payroll notified. Reopen this thread if any issue with benefits or payroll timing.
